'''Lars Elof Gustaf Brink''' (12 November 1943 - 29 October 2022) was a Swedish [[theoretical physicist]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2023-03-01 |title=Lars Brink 1943–2022 |url=https://cerncourier.com/a/lars-brink-1943-2022/ |access-date=2023-03-16 |website=CERN Courier |language=en-GB}}</ref>

He made significant and well-cited contributions in [[supersymmetry]], [[supergravity]], [[superspace]], and [[superstrings]], and the connections among them.<ref>Brink, L., Di Vecchia, P., & Howe, P. (1976). "A locally supersymmetric and reparametrization invariant action for the spinning string", ''Physics Letters'' '''B65'''(5), 471-474.  {{doi|10.1016/0370-2693(76)90445-7}}; {{cite journal|last1=Green|first1=Michael|last2=Schwarz|first2=John|last3=Brink|first3=Lars|
title = N=4 Yang-Mills and N=8 Supergravity as Limits of String Theories| doi = 10.1016/0550-3213(82)90336-4| journal = Nucl Phys|
volume = B198|pages = 474–492 | year = 1982|issue=3 |bibcode=1982NuPhB.198..474G }}</ref> In 1977, with John Schwarz and [[Joël Scherk]], he introduced  the first supersymmetric Yang-Mills theories.<ref name="BrinkSchwarz1977">{{cite journal|last1=Brink|first1=Lars|last2=Schwarz|first2=John |last3=Scherk|first3=Joël|title=Supersymmetric Yang-Mills theories|journal=Nuclear Physics |volume=B121|issue=1|year=1977|pages=77–92|issn=0550-3213|doi=10.1016/0550-3213(77)90328-5|bibcode=1977NuPhB.121...77B}}</ref>

During 1971–1973, he was member of the theory group at [[CERN]].<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{cite web |url=http://inspirehep.net/author/profile/L.Brink.1 | title=Inspire author profile page for Brink, Lars}}</ref>

Starting in 1986, he had been  professor of theoretical physics at [[Chalmers Institute of Technology]] in [[Gothenburg]].<ref>{{cite news|title=UM RECEIVES FORMER NOBEL COMMITTEE CHAIRMAN|url=http://macaudailytimes.com.mo/um-receives-former-nobel-committee-chairman.html|accessdate=3 October 2016|work=[[Macau Daily Times]]|date=February 4, 2016}}</ref> Brink was one of the pioneers of superstring theory, since the 1970s (at CERN and Caltech). He coordinated the EU network Superstring Theory 1991–1995 and 2000–2008.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://groups.oist.jp/cws/event/seminar-alfred-nobel-and-nobel-prizes-prof-lars-brink | title= Seminar "Alfred Nobel and the Nobel Prizes" by Prof. Lars Brink (see "biography")| date= 5 December 2016}}</ref>

In 1997 he became a member of the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.kva.se/en/contact/Kontakt-sida/?personId=1995 | title= The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences : members}}</ref>

In 2001, 2004 and from 2008 to 2013 he was a member of the [[Nobel Committee for Physics]] and its chairman in 2013.<ref>{{Cite web |title=In Memory of Lars Brink (1943 – 2022) |url=https://www.worldscientific.com/do/10.1142/news20221109.136064/full/ |access-date=2023-03-16 |website=www.worldscientific.com |language=en |doi=10.1142/news20221109.136064|doi-broken-date=12 July 2025 }}</ref>
